subject: Culture
title: The Hajj
description: A quick, practical guide to The Hajj.

hook.text: Two million Muslims wear identical white garments and circle the same black cube in Mecca every year.

buildup.text: The Hajj is one of Islam's five pillars. Every Muslim who can afford it must perform it once in their lifetime.

discovery.text: The white ihram clothing erases visible class. Kings and laborers become indistinguishable in the crowd.

twist.text: Malcolm X's Hajj transformed his views on race. Seeing all colors circle together shattered his separatism.

climax.text: Logistics rival a military operation. Saudi Arabia deploys AI, drones, and 100,000 police to manage the flow.

punchline.text: The world's largest annual gathering runs on faith and engineering.

quiz.question: Whose worldview was transformed by participating in the Hajj?
